scope: Exact ready 21-pair candidate: a bounded opening-and-author-supported causal history. Not the old 57-pair root, a full-book reading or published RU translation certificate.

essential.assessment: 10 pairs read continuously in RU and EN. Real infrastructure → private financing → boom/speculation → funding panic → monetary change → debt and political aftermath is intelligible. SR-01 identifies its missing monetary causal bridge; the rest is supported. No personal investment advice or false post-crash start date.

core.assessment: 17 pairs read continuously in RU and EN. Adds the other ceremonies, savers, war-related flows, family caution, uneven output/recessions and Reconstruction. These enrich the same selected argument without inventing later chapters. SR-01 remains; no new route-specific defect found.

deep.assessment: 21 pairs read in order in RU and EN. Adds the Verne passage, Rothschild intermediation, bimetallism disagreement and Egyptian bonds. Author judgments remain judgments. SR-01 remains and SR-02 corrects the recorded Egypt exchange.

Two local corrections are needed from already available primary evidence; no essential unresolved source gap was found for this scope. Later family/Ottoman/book-ending detail stays unverified. Publication-year trivia does not determine this verdict.
substantiveParityAssessment: All 21 RU/EN titles/bodies and bilingual metadata/source/method notes read, plus all three cumulative sequences. Quantities, events and qualifications match across languages. Both substantive defects occur in both languages; no separate material translation mismatch found. No invented scene, modern personal financial prescription or mandatory reader lesson found elsewhere.

findings.kind: omission of the retained author causal explanation
findings.exactRu: Ахамед придаёт этому решению Бисмарка большое значение: ослабляется прежняя система связи золотых и серебряных денег.
findings.exactEn: Ahamed gives Bismarck’s decision great importance: the earlier link between gold and silver currencies weakens.
findings.why: This stops at the currency link. The next retained screen introduces deflation, without saying how the monetary change contributes to it. The promised explanation of the long aftermath thus loses Ahamed’s connecting monetary argument in every route. The corrected 1871–1873 chronology itself is supported.

smallestFaithfulCorrection.ru: Добавить после этой фразы: «По Ахамеду, демонетизация серебра сокращала международные денежные резервы и усиливала долгую дефляцию». Сохранить существующую хронологию и авторскую атрибуцию.
smallestFaithfulCorrection.en: Add after this sentence: “In Ahamed’s account, demonetizing silver contracted international monetary reserves and intensified the prolonged deflation.” Keep the existing chronology and attribution.

findings.primaryLocator: Actual Ahamed answer at 16:51–18:20: silver sales, falling silver prices and contraction of international reserves; 34:24 on monetary mismanagement and prolonged falling prices.

additionalPrimarySupport.locator: Ahamed replies immediately before On bimetallism and the gold standard (web transcript lines 108–109); gold-supply exchange lines 117–122.

findings.sourceBoundary: Author’s argued causal interpretation in his book interviews; not independently proved counterfactual and not a reconstruction of an unseen chapter.

findings.exactRu: Коуэн спрашивает, доказывает ли это корыстный мотив вторжения; Ахамед не принимает такого простого вывода. Связь интересов видна, но намерение человека нельзя восстановить из неё одной.
findings.exactEn: Cowen asks whether this proves a profit motive for invasion; Ahamed rejects that simple inference. Interests overlap, but an intention cannot be reconstructed from that overlap alone.
findings.why: The recorded exchange has the opposite allocation of the challenge: Ahamed raises the conflict-of-interest question; Cowen proposes a principle-driven repayment decision combined with insider advantage; Ahamed agrees Gladstone did not invade to profit on the bonds. The candidate invents Cowen’s question and turns the actual concession into a generic methodological ending. Bond ownership itself is supported.

smallestFaithfulCorrection.ru: Заменить эти две фразы: «Ахамед ставит вопрос о личной выгоде и убеждённости в обязательности выплаты долгов. Коуэн предлагает второе объяснение, а Ахамед соглашается: по его мнению, Гладстон не вторгался в Египет ради прибыли от своих облигаций».
smallestFaithfulCorrection.en: Replace these two sentences: “Ahamed raises the question of personal advantage versus a belief that debts must be repaid. Cowen proposes the latter explanation, and Ahamed agrees: in his view, Gladstone did not invade Egypt to profit from his bond holdings.”

findings.primaryLocator: Gladstone/Egypt exchange: Ahamed’s question after the repayment comparison, Cowen’s Could it be Gladstone thought…, then Ahamed’s Yes, probably… concession (web transcript lines 94–100).
findings.sourceBoundary: Reported interpretation and explicit concession in the author interview, not proof of Gladstone’s private motive. Do not reinstate the suspect oral debt figures.
